name: The Patients of Dr. García
description: In 1936 Madrid, an idealistic doctor's life changes forever when he shelters a wounded spy and joins a decades-long fight against the spread of fascism.

videos.title: Guillermo
videos.overview: After doctor Guillermo García Medina does a favor for his neighbor Amparo, an attraction begins to bloom despite their differences.

videos.title: Manuel
videos.overview: The history of Guillermo's mysterious patient reveals what brought him to Madrid and how he ended up in the crosshairs of a dangerous political faction.

videos.title: Adrian
videos.overview: Nationalist soldier Adrián Gallardo reluctantly agrees to fight in a boxing match. Romero continues to pursue Manuel. Amparo shares news.

videos.title: Breakup
videos.overview: Joy quickly gives way to sorrow as the end of the Spanish Civil War looms. With help from friends, Guillermo adjusts to a harsh new reality in Madrid.

videos.title: Secrecy
videos.overview: Guillermo, Adrián and Manuel each encounter a familiar face from their past. While Guillermo takes on a new project, Clara plans for the future.

videos.title: United
videos.overview: Setting a dangerous undercover operation in motion, Manuel and Margaret search for an identity to borrow. Guillermo turns to Geni and Amparo for help.

videos.title: Immersion
videos.overview: Margaret's doubts divide her and Manuel as he prepares to leave for Buenos Aires. Guillermo treats a patient and proposes a risky new business venture.

videos.title: The price
videos.overview: An unexpected visitor creates a painful dilemma for Guillermo, while new romance offers some comfort. Manuel entrusts key intelligence to Margaret.

videos.title: Rebirth
videos.overview: One wrong move could mean death when Manuel and Guillermo's operation is compromised. Guillermo embraces a second chance at happiness.

videos.title: Meeting again
videos.overview: In 1968, the aftermath of a student protest rattles Guillermo's comfortable family life. Seven years later, Manuel faces a life-changing decision.
